newsitem.title: SPAIN: Actor Depardieu escapes Madrid runway crash.
newsitem.headline: Actor Depardieu escapes Madrid runway crash.

text.p: French actor Gerard Depardieu escaped unhurt when a small plane in which he was travelling was in collision with a Boeing 727 on the ground at Madrid's Barajas airport on Friday night, airport officials said on Saturday.
The Boeing, which had just arrived from the Portuguese city of Oporto, and the French-registered Falcon-10 aircraft collided at a point where two runways cross.

The Falcon-10 was seriously damaged but the Boeing, which the airport information service said belonged to Portugalia airline, suffered only minor damage to a wing. There were no injuries in either plane.
Depardieu had flown to Madrid to record a programme for Spanish state television and headed straight for television studios after the incident.
The accident did not disrupt air traffic at the airport, officials said.
